title: The Pólya–Vinogradov inequality with log log q for every character: paper, Lean 4 library and checking programs
description:
Final revision of the paper, single column (amsart), 51 pages, with its LaTeX source, programs that check the explicit constants of the proofs and compute the character sums for small moduli, and a Lean 4 library. The paper proves, with no hypothesis, that M(χ) ≤ C √q log log q for every primitive Dirichlet character χ modulo q ≥ 3, with an absolute constant C, where M(χ) is the largest modulus of a partial sum of χ, and that |L'/L(1, χ)| ≤ C log log q for every nonprincipal character; and, from Chebyshev's bounds alone, that for every ε > 0 at most q^ε of the primitive characters modulo q have M(χ) > C_ε √q log log q and at most q^ε of the nonprincipal characters have |L'/L(1, χ)| > C_ε log log q. The proof is a transfer theorem for a single character, proved by a contour shift, the circle method and a weak Montgomery–Vaughan bound from Selberg's sieve; a count of the exceptional characters by a zero-density theorem proved in full in Appendix A with explicit constants; and the zero-free half-plane Re s > 11/12 for all finite-order Hecke L-functions over Q(√−3), due to OpenAI (The quasi-Riemann hypothesis: a cubic theta argument with a fixed ray class character, 5 October 2026), whose proof is reproduced in full in Appendix B with credit to them, so that the paper is complete in itself. OpenAI's Lean 4 proof of the wider half-plane Re s > 7/8 is compiled from source and checked by the Lean kernel in this repository as an independent check.

The results were first made public on 15 October 2026 as release v1.0.0 of this repository (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23383715). An earlier and incomplete version of the paper appeared on Hexagon as hexagon:2610.00256.
